parameters.content:
## 1. TRIGGER
Webhook receives JotForm POST at /ugc-onboarding
JotForm sends data in inconsistent formats — the Code node handles all parsing.

## 2. PARSE & GENERATE CLIENT CODE
Handles 3 JotForm data formats:
1. body.rawRequest (JSON string)
2. Numbered q-fields (q1_whatIs, etc.)
3. Direct field names

Also generates client code: ABC-MMDD

## 3. GOOGLE SHEETS — Client Database
Appends a row with all 28 columns (A–AB) to the main client database sheet.
Placeholder document ID — replace with your actual Google Sheet ID.

## 4. CLICKUP — Create Folder (HTTP Request)
POST /api/v2/space/90165772240/folder
Creates "[Brand] - UGC" folder. Uses HTTP Request to bypass n8n ClickUp node dropdown issues.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.folder_name }) }}

parameters.content:
## 4b. CLICKUP — Create Onboarding Doc
POST /api/v3/workspaces/90161381822/docs
Creates a ClickUp Doc inside the brand folder so
the script writer has the full onboarding brief in one place.
Then edits the first page with all form data formatted in markdown.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.brand_name + ' — Onboarding Brief', parent: { id: String($('Create Client Folder').first().json.id), type: 5 } }) }}

={{ (() => { const d = $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json; const content = '# ' + d.brand_name + ' — Onboarding Brief

' + '**Client Code:** ' + d.client_code + '
' + '**Client Name:** ' + d.client_name + '
' + '**Email:** ' + d.client_email + '
' + '**WhatsApp:** ' + d.whatsapp_number + '
' + '**Website:** ' + d.website_url + '

' + '---

' + '## Product & Positioning
' + '**Product / Feature:** ' + d.product_feature + '
' + '**Differentiator:** ' + d.differentiator + '
' + '**Competitors:** ' + d.competitors + '
' + '**Competitor Strengths:** ' + d.competitor_strengths + '
' + '**Selling Proposition:** ' + d.selling_proposition + '

' + '---

' + '## Target Audience
' + '**Target User:** ' + d.target_user + '
' + '**Biggest Problem:** ' + d.biggest_problem + '
' + '**Main Hesitation:** ' + d.main_hesitation + '
' + '**Transformation:** ' + d.transformation + '

' + '---

' + '## Brand & Creative
' + '**Brand Personality:** ' + d.brand_personality + '
' + '**Credibility Point:** ' + d.credibility_point + '
' + '**Social Proof:** ' + d.social_proof + '
' + '**Best Concepts:** ' + d.best_concepts + '
' + '**Reference Ads:** ' + d.reference_ads + '

' + '---

' + '## Rules & Compliance
' + '**Compliance:** ' + d.compliance + '
' + '**Do NOT Say:** ' + d.do_not_say + '

' + '---

' + '## Assets & Notes
' + '**Available Assets:** ' + d.available_assets + '
' + '**Number of Scripts:** ' + d.num_scripts + '
' + '**Additional Notes:** ' + d.additional_notes; return JSON.stringify({ name: d.brand_name + ' — Onboarding Brief', content: content, content_format: 'text/md' }); })() }}

parameters.content:
## 5. CLICKUP — Create List (HTTP Request)
POST /api/v2/folder/{id}/list
Creates pipeline list inside new folder. Uses HTTP Request to bypass dropdown issues.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.list_name }) }}

parameters.content:
## 6. GENERATE TASKS + UGC SCRIPT CARDS
Code node builds an array of 10 onboarding tasks with:
- Due dates (today + N days as Unix ms)
- Priorities (1=urgent → 4=low)
- Rich descriptions with client context

Also generates N UGC script cards named:
UGC_C{N}_{Brand}_Creator Name_R1_{Mon'YY}
where N = num_scripts from JotForm.

## 7. SPLIT & CREATE TASKS (HTTP Request)
Loops through 10 tasks one at a time (batch size 1)
to avoid ClickUp rate limits.
POST /api/v2/list/{id}/task — uses HTTP Request node.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $json.name, description: $json.description, due_date: $json.due_date, priority: $json.priority }) }}

parameters.content:
## 8. SLACK NOTIFICATION
Posts to #channel C07MN9QA1R7 with a summary of the new client.
Non-critical — continues on fail so it doesn't block the workflow.

## 9. ONBOARDING LOG
Appends a success record to the Onboarding Log sheet.
Tracks which steps ran and any errors.

## 10. RESPOND TO WEBHOOK
Returns JSON to JotForm with status, client code, and brand name.
This is the "Last Node" response for the webhook.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', client_code: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.client_code, brand: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.brand_name }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

parameters.content:
## ERROR HANDLING
If any node in the main flow fails, this error branch:
1. Sends a Slack DM to U06P9F49BJT
2. Logs the failure to the Onboarding Log sheet
3. Returns 200 to prevent JotForm retry loops

## 5b. CLICKUP — Create Chat Channel in Space
POST /api/v3/workspaces/90161381822/chat/channels/location
Creates channel inside Space 90165772240 (not at workspace level).
If a channel already exists on the space, returns it.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $("Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code").first().json.channel_name, parent_id: "90165772240", parent_type: "space" }) }}

parameters.content:
## TEST TRIGGER
Click "Test workflow" to run the entire flow with demo data.
No webhook needed — Manual Trigger outputs raw form data that
flows through the Parse node, so all downstream references work.
Disable this path in production by deactivating the Manual Trigger node.

## 8. GOOGLE DRIVE — Client Folder Setup
Finds the alphabet folder (A-Z) in shared Clients drive,
creates Brand folder + References & Scripts subfolders.
Then creates N Google Docs (one per UGC script) in Scripts.

Clients folder ID: 1tsbdVo92ECUyUCaCwvq1yGCRpA4uCDxT

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.brand_name, mimeType: 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder', parents: [$json.files[0].id] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ name: 'References', mimeType: 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder', parents: [$json.id] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ name: 'Scripts', mimeType: 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder', parents: [$('Create Brand Folder in Drive').first().json.id] }) }}

parameters.content:
## 9. GOOGLE DOCS — Script Documents
Generates N empty Google Docs in the Scripts subfolder.
Doc names match the ClickUp UGC script card names:
UGC_C{N}_{Brand}_Creator Name_R1_{Mon'YY}

Script writers open these docs and start writing.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ $json._skip ? JSON.stringify({}) : JSON.stringify({ name: $json.name, mimeType: 'application/vnd.google-apps.document', parents: [$json.scriptsFolderId] }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
// Collapse loop output into a single item for Drive operations
return [{ json: { ready: true } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: "onboarding", event_type: "status_change", severity: "info", brand_name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.brand_name, client_code: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.client_code, message: "New project onboarded: " + $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.brand_name, payload: JSON.stringify({ client_code: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.client_code, brand_name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.brand_name, num_scripts: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.num_scripts }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}
={{ JSON.stringify($json.scout_request) }}
